Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone to close on the evaluation by end of June, I wanted to align on the outstanding security/compliance gates so we can sign the DPA and get procurement moving. High level asks from NovaFin we noted: SOC 2 report access, SIG/CAIQ matrix, DPA redline + data retention term, and an escrow/residency option for archived evaluation data.

Action items we propose from Redwood:
- Share SOC 2 summary + relevant SOC 2 report excerpt (if available) — target: 2027-06-16
- Deliver populated SIG/CAIQ matrix for your controls team — target: 2027-06-16
- Provide a single DPA redline we can discuss and iterate — attached draft: proposed-dpa-redline.docx
- Outline data retention/escrow options (cost and timeline) and KMS integration notes — proposal below

Data retention / escrow options (for evaluation):
1) Short-term evaluation (30 days) — no escrow fee, data purged after 30 days
2) Standard evaluation (90 days) — encrypted archive retained in EU until deletion; escrow available for an additional 1-month fee
3) Extended (730 days) — archival + escrow with quarterly attestations (enterprise add-on)

Please confirm which retention option you prefer and whether NovaFin requires independent escrow custody (we can route to a third-party escrow agent) or Redwood-managed encrypted archives (customer-managed KMS/HSM support available).

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, proposed-dpa-redline.docx

If helpful we can do a 30-min call this week to close the DPA redlines and retention choice — Jordan and Rachel will join.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
